name: How much should ADU design cost in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much should ADU design cost in Los Angeles for a custom backyard unit?
mainEntity.text: How much should ADU design cost in Los Angeles for a custom backyard unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: ADU design fees vary widely because not all projects require the same level of effort. A straightforward garage conversion will usually cost less to design than a fully custom detached unit, especially if the property needs a survey, structural engineering, or detailed permit responses. The design fee often reflects how much coordination is needed to turn the concept into a permit-ready plan set. Homeowners should also factor in whether the designer includes revisions, engineering coordination, and city correction responses in the base fee. A lower fee is not always the better value if it results in incomplete drawings or extra charges later. The best way to compare proposals is to look at deliverables, not just price. A clear scope of work should explain what drawings are included, how many revisions are covered, and what support continues through permitting.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU design cost depends on project complexity, survey needs, consultant coordination, and permit support. Simple projects cost less, while custom or hillside designs cost more because they require more drafting, revisions, and engineering coordination.
